locator: V.4.1; compare V.4.2 productive activity and VI.9.1–6 (not yet read in this investigation)
goal: Independently defend the exact bridges from constitutive need for internal simples to proper-component priority or actual cause-in-esse, and from first-principle genuine unity/global scope to exclusion of plural independent simples. Reuse existing simplicity and uniqueness certificates only after matching their premises; compare the priority-monist basic composite cosmos and immanent-form account.
reason: V.4.1 supplies an explicit parts-to-composite dependence argument and asserts uniqueness, but individual simplicity alone does not establish global unity, causal correspondence, existence or individuation. No root premise is discharged by attributing the conclusion to Plotinus.
